text:
Lena: Quick results from sparrow-13b bring-up. Ran float16, int6, int4 on mixed summarization + QA slices (avg output ~700 tokens). Need routing recs.

Omar: Data? sample sizes?

Lena: 1500 prompts, human spot n=200. eval-bot table below.

eval-bot: |metric|fp16|int6|int4|
|---|---:|---:|---:|
|ROUGE-L|43.7|42.0|40.8|
|QA F1|79.2|77.4|74.6|
|Hallucination|3.9%|5.2%|8.1%|
|Cost/1k tokens|$0.138|$0.112|$0.066|

Pri: int4 cost win huge (~52% vs fp16), but quality drop on QA and hallucination jump is worrying. Short summaries look OK on int4.

Omar: Latency? int4 p50 ~15% faster, p95 no change. So main driver is cost.

Lena: Unit econ: switching all traffic to int4 saves ~$72k/mo at 1M daily tokens. But likely product regression for QA-heavy features.

Pri: Recommendation: default int6; allow int4 for short-summary routes (expected_output<300) and non-fact slices. Holdback 15% for 2 weeks with GTN slow ramp. Add immediate fallback to int6 if hallucination +1.5ppt over baseline.

Omar: +1. Also suggest small shadowing on VIP customers (fp16) to confirm no silent regressions.

Lena: Routing proto: {"routes":[{"cond":"expected_output<300 and slice==short_summary","model":"sparrow-13b-int4"},{"cond":"slice==qa or expected_output>=300","model":"sparrow-13b-int6"},{"cond":"vip","model":"sparrow-13b-fp16"}],"holdback":15,"fallback":"sparrow-13b-int6"}

Pri: I'll set up ROUGE-L, F1, and hallucination dashboards and a lightweight human NPS sample for the holdback.

Omar: Add an ngram-repetition monitor for long outputs.

Lena: Filing the scorecard (slices: short-summary, long-summary, QA). Flag name: sparrow13-routing-v1. Staging rollout tomorrow. :thumbsup:
